title: Refusal
description: The body of every refusal outside MCP (a wrong or late pairing code, a caller off the tailnet, a request without the paired hub's key, a version the agent does not speak), and the structured answer of a call refused as already run.

error.description: What went wrong, in words a person can act on.

code.description: What went wrong, for the hub to read. A version 1 agent always sends it; version 0 sends only error. A hub treats a code it does not know as a refusal and passes on error.

versions.description: With unsupported_version: the versions this agent speaks.
